name: Second Stone: The Legend of the Hidden World
detailed_description:
With so many modern games being reliant on violence, dark themes and horror, Second Stone brings back the colorful golden age of gaming all reimagined with today's technology, innovation and modern game mechanics!

Imagine your favorite platformer game but with swords, spells, loot and skill trees! Add on top of that a fun and intricate leveling system! Second Stone offers a strong combination of platforming and Action-RPG elements all fused together to bring one of the most engaging game experiences ever seen on Steam!

Jump seamlessly between a beautiful world brimming with life and adventure... and a dark mirror world filled with mystery, danger and vicious monsters! In Second Stone you will experience a nostalgic and epic journey that centers around the two fully playable parallel worlds!

Experience an open interconnected world filled with lush environments and charming characters. On top of that, in this world, you'll find huge temples that offer a procedural Rogue-Like spin on the gameplay that tests your ability to create the best build based on what you manage to find before encountering the extremely challenging Depth Bosses!

Find elemental Manastones and attach them to your weapons and gear for different powerful effects!

-Do you need to freeze enemies from afar? Attach a Rimestone to your bow!
-Do you want to become a storm mage? Attach a Sparkstone to your magic armlet!
-Struggling with monsters that deal fire damage? Attach an Emberstone to your armor!

Fuse the excess Manastones you find to level up the ones you have attached to your gear to unlock new elemental effects, abilities and spells!

For example, a fireball cast from a Rough Emberstone simply launches one projectile towards your enemy, but a fireball cast from a Radiant Emberstone can be customized to break into three projectiles that start homing in on their targets that then explode like a cluster bomb on impact, dealing damage to surrounding enemies.

Combine the endlessly modular Manastone system with the weapons and gear you find, in addition to the Astral Tablet skill tree system to create thousands of different character builds where only your imagination is the limit!

short_description: A story-driven adventure game fusing platforming with fast-paced RPG combat. Jump between two worlds as Shiren, a young treasure hunter from Arimaya Village in search of the secret behind the dark hidden world. Experience an epic hero's journey with a slice of nostalgia and truly fun gameplay!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
